scope: Third-party code in the Windows portable build: Qt's Windows binaries and the Microsoft C++ runtime beside Kino.exe, the libraries scripts/build-windows-mpv.sh links into libmpv-2.dll, and what vcpkg and Rust link into kino-stream-engine.exe. The npm packages, Core, and the engine's Cargo graph come from the shared collectors.

components.name: mpv
components.notes: libmpv-2.dll, which scripts/build-windows-mpv.sh cross-compiles with every library below linked in. Built as libmpv only with the default -Dgpl=true, so the result is GPL-2.0-or-later, and with the GPL-3.0-or-later FFmpeg below the combination is distributed under GPL-3.0-or-later. Copyright says some files use BSD, MIT, or ISC terms; like FFmpeg, those per-file headers are not enumerated here. libmpv embeds sub/osd_font.otf, whose glyphs upstream says came from a freely licensed font such as Symbola; their original terms are not recorded upstream.

components.name: FFmpeg
components.license: GPL-3.0-or-later; IJG notices retained for libjpeg-derived code
components.notes: Linked statically into libmpv-2.dll, configured with --enable-gpl and --enable-version3, so per LICENSE.md the libraries as built are GPL version 3 or later. The LGPL and GPLv2 texts are kept because LICENSE.md names them as the underlying terms of individual files. Built with FFmpeg's own decoders, dav1d, D3D11VA, DXVA2, zlib, iconv, and Schannel, and nothing autodetected. The IJG-derived files named by LICENSE.md keep their complete initial comment blocks. Like the macOS and Linux reviews, this entry does not enumerate the other library files whose own headers carry MIT, BSD, ISC, or zlib terms.

components.name: libass
components.notes: Linked statically into libmpv-2.dll, with DirectWrite for fonts and its x86 assembly, which carries x264's ISC notice. libass/wyhash.h is released under the Unlicense and asks for no notice.

components.name: libplacebo
components.notes: Linked statically into libmpv-2.dll from the tag's commit with its submodules, for OpenGL only. Its OpenGL loader comes from glad, whose generated code is (WTFPL OR CC0-1.0) AND Apache-2.0 with Khronos header terms, and src/convert.cc includes fast_float, under Apache-2.0, BSL-1.0, or MIT. Its jinja and markupsafe submodules only run at build time.

components.name: uchardet
components.notes: Linked statically into libmpv-2.dll. COPYING holds all three license texts; the retained uchardet.cpp header carries the Netscape copyright line every library source shares.

components.name: freetype
components.notes: Linked statically into libmpv-2.dll for libass, under the FreeType License. Portions of this software are copyright © 2026 The FreeType Project (https://freetype.org). All rights reserved. The build uses the zlib below rather than FreeType's bundled copy; the review's other secondary notices apply as retained.

components.name: harfbuzz
components.notes: Linked statically into libmpv-2.dll for libass. Its generated Universal Shaping Engine table carries Microsoft's data notice and Unicode's data license, both retained.

components.name: fribidi
components.notes: Linked statically into libmpv-2.dll for libass. Kino's source and scripts/build-windows-mpv.sh are the corresponding source and the means to relink against a modified FriBidi.

components.name: dav1d
components.notes: Linked statically into libmpv-2.dll for FFmpeg's AV1 decoding. Its x86 assembly is built on x264's x86inc.asm, whose ISC notice is retained.

components.name: lcms2
components.notes: Linked statically into libmpv-2.dll for mpv's and libplacebo's colour management. The GPL-3.0 fast-float and threaded plugins are not built.

components.name: zlib
components.notes: Linked statically into libmpv-2.dll for FFmpeg, FreeType, and mpv.

components.name: libiconv
components.notes: The library, not the iconv program, linked statically into libmpv-2.dll for subtitle character sets. Kino's source and scripts/build-windows-mpv.sh are the corresponding source and the means to relink against a modified libiconv.

components.name: MinGW-w64 runtime
components.license: ZPL-2.1 AND MIT AND BSD-3-Clause AND LicenseRef-Public-Domain
components.notes: The runtime startup code, support library, and winpthreads, which the Ubuntu MinGW-w64 toolchain links statically into libmpv-2.dll. COPYING.MinGW-w64-runtime.txt is the project's file for exactly this case: it gathers the notices a statically linked binary must carry.

components.name: GCC runtime libraries
components.notes: libgcc and libstdc++, linked statically into libmpv-2.dll by the Ubuntu MinGW-w64 GCC 13 toolchain. The GCC Runtime Library Exception lets the combined work be distributed under its own terms; the texts are included as a record.

components.name: libtorrent-rasterbar
components.notes: Linked statically into the engine, built by vcpkg's libtorrent port as patch 0009 pins it, without WebTorrent. try_signal, puff, and ed25519 are compiled on Windows and kept; route.h is included only for iOS.

components.name: boost
components.notes: Header code compiled into the engine through libtorrent, from vcpkg's Boost 1.92.0 ports. BOOST-HEADER-NOTICES.txt was assembled from preprocessing on macOS; Windows includes different platform headers, so the aggregate is approximate for this build.

components.name: openssl
components.notes: Linked statically into the engine for libtorrent's encrypted connections, built by vcpkg's openssl port at the baseline patch 0009 pins.

components.name: rust-standard-library
components.notes: The engine is built with the Rust release apps/stream-engine/rust-toolchain.toml pins, the one the macOS engine uses.
